## QA Run 25 Summary — UI Walk

**Result: 0 broken features. 0 fixes needed. 0 commits.**

Walked 13 of 14 requested routes via Playwright; closes carry-over #11 (no UI walk in 19 runs).

| Route | Result |
|---|---|
| `/` (Dashboard) | 14-stage pipeline, 5 stat cards, leaderboard, AR, stale leads, days-in-stage — all real data |
| `/storm-map` | Map canvas 1905×1905, layers panel, address search, transparency bar |
| `/pipeline` | 21 draggable cards across stages |
| `/leads` + `/leads/:id` | Table 21 rows × 16 cols; deep-link opens slide-over LeadDetail (routing via `useParams` in LeadList is intentional) |
| `/estimates` | 50 rows, builder available |
| `/invoices` | 16 rows |
| `/work-orders` | Kanban with 14 cards across Pending/Scheduled etc. |
| `/tasks` | Pending/Completed tabs, overdue pill |
| `/calendar` | May 2026, 49 day cells, 64 events |
| `/reports` | All 7 chart sections render |
| `/canvassing` | Satellite map with pins, Drop Pin |
| `/settings` | All 14 tabs switch cleanly (Profile, Company, Billing, Payments, Team, Storm Alerts, Notifications, Email/SMTP, Financing, Automations, Drip Sequences, Custom Fields, Pricing/Line Items, Reviews) |
| `/content-studio` | Not in `App.jsx` Route table → catch-all redirects to `/`. Referenced only in old docs; feature was never implemented. Added as carry-over #15. |

**Console errors:** Only the 6 known pre-auth 401s during cold load (carry-over #7). Network capture confirmed root cause is token expiry at boot, not missing header — request interceptor IS synchronous and DOES attach the token. Response interceptor refreshes and retries (all final responses are 200). Real fix requires proactive expiry check in `client/src/api/client.js` — behavioral change to working auth, left alone per task constraints.

Resume file updated at `memory/overnight_resume.md` with full Run 25 details and next-run priorities.
